profile.headline: Owner
profile.summary:
Project Engineering Management, Software Development Manager. Java, C++, C, Perl, HTML. Development. Unix, Linux, Windows. ARINC-653, ARINC-661, FACE.

Patent holder of US Patent #5,995,903. Method and System for Assisting Navigation Using Terrain Imagery.

positions.title: IRAD Lead/Project Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Project Management for a FACE™ conformant application. Engineering lead for a software  development activity of a certifiable FACE™ and DO-178C application to gain knowledge of the FACE™ Verification and Certification Process. Responsibilities include scheduling, budget, requirements development and day to day management of the development activities. 
• Software Development of a FACE™ ARINC-661 User Application (UA) and Definition File (DF) development for 2019 FACE™ Technical Interchange Meeting (TIM) demonstration. Developed a rudimentary ARINC-661 Cockpit Display System (CDS) Server to support development before commercial CDS was added to the demonstration.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Web Application Developer. Project Manager. Sr. Symbian C++ Developer.

positions.title: President/CEO
positions.description:
- Overall management of a small corporation, including: Hiring, Purchasing. Marketing. Sales. And all Financials Development including all accounting (AR, AP, GL, and Payroll). PeachTree, Aatrix. 
- Development and maintenance of business and financial planning. Including development of business plan, cash flow analysis, and financial projections.  Biz Plan Pro, MS Excel, MS Word, FastTrack Project Scheduler, Photoshop, Pagemaker, Macintosh, Windows 95/NT.
